description: ATLANTA – State Representatives Rhonda Burnough (D-Riverdale) and El-Mahdi Holly (D-Stockbridge) were recently recognized at Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority Inc.’s Psi Alpha Omega Chapter Emerald Gala, where Rep.
